We can play with the TIEs, but we're much better suited to unloading on that ugly hunk of metal the warlord is driving.|Garik Loran to Nova Three|<ref name="if" />}}
This '''Nova Three ''' flew a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] as part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Nova Squadron/Legends|Nova Squadron]]. During the [[Hunt for Zsinj|campaign]] against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], this pilot participated in the [[Battle for the Razor's Kiss|battle]] for the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Razor's Kiss]]''.<ref name="if" />
